svg.title: lit_test_room: the review's painted room (not shipped art)
svg.desc: The solid mass of tests/screenshot/rooms/lit_test.room drawn as hand-cut shapes, so that the review shows a background through the ink shaders (ink_background: the open, broken line that drops out where the light hits, the brush and the grain). Walls, floor and ceiling are one part (overlapping subpaths are a union), the ledge and the crate are their own. Edges lie within 2 u of the room's tile edges, which is what the shadows are cast from. Behind them stand a far wall and three pillars, so that the line, the brush and the grain are judged over a surface the ember crosses, not over black.
